The '''Kwilaan Starport''' was a [[spaceport]] in the [[city]] of [[Keren]] on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] of [[Naboo]]. It was the largest facility of its kind in the Mid Rim and was used by many travelers. The port was larger than the [[Theed Spaceport]], which had been built in Naboo's [[capital]] city of [[Theed]]<ref name="Altaya" /> between [[32 BBY]] and [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The portion of [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] that covers the locations of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] states that the [[Theed Spaceport]] was built after the [[Battle of Naboo]], dated to [[32 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''. As ''Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition'' dates the events of ''Attack of the Clones'' to [[22 BBY]], the [[spaceport]] must have been built between those two [[Standard year|years]].</ref> [[Shuttle]]s and [[repulsorlift transport]]s from the Kwilaan Starport took individuals to Theed's spaceport. The starport shared its name with [[Kwilaan]],<ref name="Altaya" /> a [[human]] who discovered Naboo.<ref name="SW">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/crisis-on-naboo-trivia-gallery|text="Crisis on Naboo" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kwilaan Starport was mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in "[[Naboo (reference book)|Naboo]]," an issue of [[De Agostini|Altaya's]] [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']]<ref name="Altaya" /> published on [[December 16]], [[2020]].<ref name="Altaya date">{{Altaya|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> The [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Starport]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'', a [[2001]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook published for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Legends">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> It then made its first appearance in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=location|Kwilaan starport|[[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]}}</ref>
